reviewer: Independent research/content reviewer; no teaching-page authorship
scope: All ten public static unscored Topic Guides AC9E1LY06–LY15. All prompts/answers/explanations/activities, retained lessons, actual supplied stimuli/models and asset bytes.
identity_authority: The exact reviewed page/asset SHA256 values below are authoritative even if evidence-only commits follow.
source_checks: Independently executed scripts/qa_year1_english_topic_pages_batch3.py against baseline: PASS. All 430 authored teaching strings independently resolved in actual page text. Exact metadata, 67 baseline-plus-recorded-repair teaching sections, original inline SVG geometry, routes, available resource links, app return/access metadata checked by the executed scoped checker; no app-bank certification.

semantic_review.all_codes: Read all 440 scalar fields and all 67 final retained sections plus ten earlier worked models. Checked each supplied task and answer independently: givens, answer fit, permissible alternatives, sound order/count, common pattern and standard spelling, sentence context, Year 1 boundaries, accessible observation and wording. No remaining content blocker.
semantic_review.LY06: Report facts supplied; opinions accept supported alternatives; recount order explicit; learner-created drawings and digital images/captions actually required; edits justified. Rabbit fur/ears image supports supplied claims, no hidden identity inferred.
semantic_review.LY07: Topic/opening/middle/conclusion and useful vocabulary match complete records. Clap-game rules support recommendation. Gesture captions admit contextual meanings; volume/pace require actual delivery without gaze/accent/confidence scores.
semantic_review.LY08: Actual school-taught unjoined handwriting, both cases and word-gap evidence separated from typing/spelling. Functional grip and classroom models respect variation; stroke/line examples independently inspected as pixels.
semantic_review.LY09: All phoneme counts/sequences checked: shop/fish three; stop/flag/swim/nest/lamp/frog/best/clap four; stretch stamp five is permitted here. Clusters retain each consonant and digraphs differ. No four-sound cap imported from LY10.
semantic_review.LY10: All add/replace/delete examples solved and positions checked, including internal sip→slip, ram→ramp, sand minus /n/→sad, clap minus /k/→lap versus minus /l/→cap. All one syllable, at most four phonemes including smile despite five letters. Familiar lap/cap replaces uncommon sop; printed givens explicitly adult-only during oral checks.
semantic_review.LY11: Short/common long vowels, digraph/blend distinction and one/two-syllable reading/spelling valid. Sorting axes now explicitly separate/overlap. Hidden spelling versus visible independent decoding distinguished.
semantic_review.LY12: Actual given comparisons implement both elaborations: same letter/different sounds and same /s/ with s/c. Vowel sounds rather than letters control syllable counts; rain one, raincoat two, robot two, cake one. The optional syllable theory answer is bounded to actual taught Year 1 words and does not overreach to all linguistic theory.
semantic_review.LY13: Standard rabbit bb explicitly taught rather than inferred from syllables. Correct picnic final c and chicken ck rely on taught/common patterns; independent dictation hides model. All word forms and two-syllable component orders checked.
semantic_review.LY14: Complete familiar word mapping, accurate context reading, supported retrieval/retention distinction and hidden models coherent. Two prior ambiguous tasks now accept other familiar words or target the unique o spelling in some. Final heading says spelling noticing, not an unsupported memory claim.
semantic_review.LY15: Meaningful bases distinguished from rhyme; noun/verb s, ed and ing checked in full sentences. am playing now versus was playing yesterday prevents universal ing=now. Compounds distinguished from grammatical endings; spelling changes require explicit teaching.

repairs_rechecked: All recorded retained repairs reviewed, including the baseline flags. Final LY14 heading and LY10 familiar-word replacement were rechecked in actual HTML/JSON. LY15 metadata-only earlier-model takeaway deletion rechecked without changing actual worked question/answer or SVG.

optional_backlog.note: The retained rabbit question phrasing remains awkward; its explicit standard-spelling answer now prevents the old doubling inference. Optional wording polish, not a correctness blocker.

asset_pixel_review: Opened all seven actual raster originals individually: paintbrush, fan, three gestures, rabbit and matching LY06 paid cover. Rendered and opened all seven exact SVG asset files. Also rendered/opened all thirteen retained inline SVGs individually for labels, counts, relationships and glyph/geometry. All pass in that local semantic-pixel scope.
local_render_method: Inkscape renders of extracted inline SVGs restored the HTML parser lowercased viewbox attribute to XML viewBox for faithful local extraction; initial default-size clipped extraction was discarded and all affected models reopened. No page source was edited. Final hosted browser geometry, mobile layout and interactions remain a separate review.
commercial_plan_closure: PASS; see independent-plan-commercial-recheck.json. Nine distinct original paid links and one cover preserved, including LY06/LY07 hero destinations. No assertion of linked paid-pack contents beyond preserved existing listing/cover.
limits: Not a blind scored-bank, human teacher, pupil trial, mastery or attainment certification.
Did not inspect or change app banks, paid pack interiors, slides or worksheets. Existing destinations are preserved rather than newly certified.
Local SVG/raster semantic checks are not hosted browser viewport verification. A fresh separate final reviewer must inspect exact hosted pixels and repairs/high-risk content under current SOP.
